permissions.comment: The title bar is drawn by Windows, not by the page, so the only way it follows the app's own light/dark choice is to tell the window about it.

Check for, download and install a new version. What makes this safe to expose is the Ed25519 signature: the plugin refuses any artifact not signed by the key whose public half is in `tauri.conf.json`, so a hijacked endpoint can serve nothing the app will run.
F11. Paired with `is-fullscreen` because the toggle reads the window's own state rather than keeping its own.
Closing the window is held back for the moment an installer takes to launch, so the close has to be completed by hand afterwards.

Opening a project folder in Explorer. A project can live anywhere the user keeps one, so the scope cannot be narrower than the whole filesystem; the only paths passed are ones already in the recents list.
